purpose: Advertising as a process of creating, substantiating, distributing, measuring, and correcting consumer-facing claims.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name campaign, platform, market, jurisdiction, and date. Separate exposure from incremental effect, disclose paid relationships, and verify applicable advertising and privacy rules.
